scope: Synchronize skill facing with movement, pointer aim and selected target

rules.standing: Use the loaded actor facing until an aim intent is supplied
rules.movement: WASD, arrows and mobile use one controller; stopping preserves aim
rules.pointer: Overrides unchanged held movement; a new movement intent restores movement aim
rules.swordAndWind: Use directional aim; accepted cast direction is fixed
rules.thunder: Face the selected valid target at authoritative server acceptance
rules.inputBoundary: Wait for the next consumed movement input, rather than inserting a physics step
rules.dropOrLeave: Discard pending casts; do not replay them on reconnect
rules.receipts: Legacy command keys preserved; new keys include inputSeq; durable retries bypass the input wait

browserChecks: Loaded facing without a default east aim
Four rendered cast directions for all three actors via movement controls
Movement and skill handlers in the same frame reach release without self-cancel
Pointer priority while movement is held, stop retention and repress behavior
Thunder turns toward and hits the selected target independently of directional aim
Wind travels along accepted aim and does not retarget during its active cast
Mobile direction button and HUD fit
Reload uses the saved actor facing
E and screen NPC button after asset build/reload, reconnect and backend restart
Remote client renders confirmed VFX, independent profiles, costs, hits and dash

fixtureNotes.reason: Keep two software-rendered clients connected and observable without inactive-tab throttling
